edit.ability:
(1GCD)(Activates before items can hit this creature) Summon one:
-(1 point) Bugzzy
-(2 points) Ice Dragon
-(1PG)(3 points) Masher
At least 3 pair turns must end before another minion can be summoned.
If this creature is at full health and were to die from an attack, it will survive with 0.5 HP instead.
This ability cannot be negated or copied.
